credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.intro: Every key this app holds, and where it is kept. Paste a key here and the app puts it where it belongs — in the keychain of your Mac, or in an encrypted file. The app never shows a key again once it is stored.
credentials.vault_sub_keychain: Everything is stored in the system keychain: it is encrypted by the system, it does not travel with the app folder, and nothing of it is written in a file you could copy.
credentials.vault_sub_no_keychain: On this machine the keys go into an encrypted file, with a passphrase you choose. It is never stored, so you will be asked for it again next time.
credentials.plain_title: Some keys are in plain text
credentials.plain_body: These are readable by anyone who can read the file they sit in. Moving them takes a second and nothing is lost:
credentials.paste_new_key_ph: paste a new key to replace it
